title: Tooti Hai Kamar Kaise Bataun Ali Akbar
body:
Tooti Hai Kamar Kaise Bataun Ali Akbar
mai Kaise Teri Laash Uthaun Ali Akbar
1. Saber Ne Kaha Qabr Me Gar Izn Ataa Ho
mai Aapko Yeh Nouha Sunaun Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Uth-te Hi Nahi Mere Qadam Khaimou'n Ki Jaanib
zainab Se Tujhe Kaise Milau'n Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Abbas Ke Baazu Bhi Qalam Hogaye Ran Me
ab Kisko Madad Karne Bulau'n Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Zaqmi Tera Seena Toh Pidar Dekh Raha Hai
mai Apna Jigar Kisko Dikhau'n Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ankho'n Se Dikhyi Nahi Deta Hai Pidar Ko
mayyath Teri Lekar Kahan Jau'n Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Mannat Toh Teri Paalne Waali Ki Badhadu'n
sehra Tere Lashe Pe Sajau'n Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Yeh Haal Tera Dekh Ke Marjaye Na Bano
mai Kaise Tera Zaqm Chipau'n Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bete Ko Kafan Dena Fareeza Hai Pidar Ka
yeh Qarz Magar Kaise Chukau'n Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Sheh Bole Takallum Zara Beemaar Se Mil Lo
kis Haal Me Sughra Hai Dikhau'n Ali Akbar
